events.summary: Find the agent loop from memories to wiki to tasks to lessons, using brain/nature cycle analogies to reduce awareness bloat and discover better approaches

Local awareness already has one canonical DB and surfaces for memory, tasks, refinements, signals, query, repo inject; current workspace has 211 active memories, 560 tasks, 43 open refinements, so bloat pressure is real.
claims: Awareness loop exists but lacks a regulating navigation/workboard cycle -> local docs and query output -> moderate

events.summary: Brain/nature analogies converge on bounded cycles: active inference separates learning from past and action selection for future; sleep consolidates while forgetting/downscaling; adaptive cycles alternate accumulation with release/reorganization; stigmergy uses local environmental traces.
claims: Best agent loop should split wake execution from sleep consolidation/projection, with forgetting and projection budgets -> web sources -> moderate

events.summary: Perspective review: Critical Architect rejected another storage layer; Product wanted one front door; Visionary kept the wake/sleep metaphor because it explains bloat control. Surviving MVP is read-only workboard+navigator first, projection pruning second.
